transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Thank you for joining this approval meeting. As we all know, we have a draft notification package scheduled for approval this week regarding the cloud security incident that exposed customer account information. Before I can give final approval to the regulatory filing and customer notices, our incident-response protocol requires each responsible counsel from the participating functions to report their relevant findings. Let's go ahead and begin those reports so we can move forward with the package.

transcript.text: I need to report a critical finding before we proceed. I completed a review of the cloud-access logs and confirmed that exactly 2,736 accounts had both names and email addresses exposed together with unencrypted Social Security numbers. The preliminary incident summary that circulated earlier still lists the record count as undetermined because the forensic reconciliation was completed after that summary was distributed. This updated count needs to be reflected in the notification package before approval.

transcript.text: I need to report a critical finding regarding the Massachusetts regulatory filing. I checked the current state regulator incident portal and confirmed that, for this incident's data elements, the Massachusetts Attorney General filing must be submitted no later than the same day as the consumer notices. The filing sequence is absent from the draft package because the portal instruction changed this month. This timing requirement needs to be incorporated into the package before approval, or we risk being out of compliance with the updated Massachusetts filing deadline.

transcript.text: I need to report a critical finding from my review of the cyber policy endorsement. I confirmed that written insurer consent is required before the company promises identity-restoration services or any other remediation benefits to affected customers. I received the endorsement amendment from the broker yesterday, but I have not yet added this requirement to the notification checklist. If the customer notices include any offers of identity-restoration or similar remediation benefits, we must obtain the insurer's written consent before those promises go out, or we risk jeopardizing our coverage. This needs to be addressed in the package before approval.
